name: rust-analyzer
description: Rust language server with Windows job limits and Linux/macOS memory watchdogs

memory_limit_mib.title: Rust memory budget (MiB)
memory_limit_mib.description: Whole MiB. Windows: hard aggregate commit ceiling. Linux/macOS: soft process-group RSS budget, which may overshoot.

server.title: rust-analyzer executable
server.description: Executable on PATH or an absolute executable path. The rustup proxy respects the workspace toolchain.
